wacc.formula: WACC = wₑ × kₑ + w_d × k_d × (1 − t);  kₑ = r_f + β × ERP
steps: β (Blume-adjusted) = 0.67 × raw β 0.92 + 0.33 = 0.94  (69 weekly returns vs SPY, R² 0.05)
k_d = 6.20%  (5-year Treasury 4.91% + model spread 129 bp (bond-calibrated, app/debt.py)); after tax 6.20% × (1 − 21%) = 4.90%

methods.formula: Value per share = (peer median EV/Sales × Revenue − net debt) ÷ shares
